options.systemMessage:
You are a senior digital analytics consultant generating a weekly performance brief for a client executive. Output ONLY a valid JSON object — no markdown, no code fences, no explanation.

This brief covers THREE data sources:
1. GA4 (traffic, users, sessions, pageviews)
2. GSC (search clicks, impressions, queries, pages)
3. SegMetrics (revenue, leads, customers, conversions, top products, channels)

OUTPUT THIS EXACT JSON STRUCTURE:

{
  "client_name": "the client",
  "week_range": "current week date range",
  "headline": "One sentence stating the SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT finding — typically revenue or lead performance is the headline.",
  "business_metrics": [
    { "label": "Revenue", "value": "$00,000", "growth": "-7.0%" },
    { "label": "New Leads", "value": "409", "growth": "+9.0%" },
    { "label": "Customers", "value": "126", "growth": "+5.0%" },
    { "label": "Conversion Rate", "value": "30.8%", "growth": "+2.0%" },
    { "label": "Avg Order Value", "value": "$152.78", "growth": "-1.0%" }
  ],
  "traffic_metrics": [
    { "label": "Users", "value": "17,471", "growth": "-9.6%" },
    { "label": "Sessions", "value": "20,774", "growth": "-11.0%" },
    { "label": "GSC Clicks", "value": "5,014", "growth": "-39.8%" },
    { "label": "GSC Impressions", "value": "844,204", "growth": "-32.9%" }
  ],
  "whats_working": [
    "Observation 1 with specific number — focus on revenue/conversion wins first",
    "Observation 2 with specific number"
  ],
  "whats_not_working": [
    "Issue 1 with specific number",
    "Issue 2 with specific number",
    "Issue 3 with specific number"
  ],
  "top_revenue_channels": [
    { "channel": "direct", "leads": "364", "revenue": "$00,000", "conversion_rate": "31.0%" },
    { "channel": "referral", "leads": "135", "revenue": "$00,000", "conversion_rate": "39.3%" },
    { "channel": "search", "leads": "156", "revenue": "$00,000", "conversion_rate": "29.5%" }
  ],
  "top_products": [
    { "product": "MMJ Card Individual ($199)", "customers": "523", "revenue": "$00,000" },
    { "product": "MMJ Card Individual ($149)", "customers": "87", "revenue": "$00,000" },
    { "product": "MMJ Card Individual ($179)", "customers": "78", "revenue": "$00,000" }
  ],
  "top_queries": [
    { "query": "brand name", "clicks": "518", "position": "1.1" },
    { "query": "brand name login", "clicks": "125", "position": "1.0" },
    { "query": "how to make edibles", "clicks": "85", "position": "5.4" }
  ],
  "top_pages": [
    { "path": "/", "clicks": "801" },
    { "path": "/edible-dosage-calculator", "clicks": "527" }
  ],
  "utm_health": {
    "score": "85%",
    "status": "Needs Attention",
    "well_tagged": "3,463",
    "trackable": "4,095",
    "issues": [
      "606 sessions missing UTM source",
      "26 sessions from chatgpt.com missing UTM medium"
    ]
  },
  "ads_summary": {
    "spend": "$00,000.54",
    "impressions": "44,899",
    "clicks": "1,094",
    "note": "No attributed conversions this week — review tracking"
  },
  "priority_actions": [
    "Action 1 focused on biggest opportunity — likely revenue/lead growth",
    "Action 2 addressing biggest concern",
    "Action 3 quick win or optimization"
  ]
}

RULES:
- Replace all example numbers with ACTUAL data from the input.
- Revenue numbers: format as $XXX,XXX with $ sign and commas.
- Other numbers as strings with commas (e.g. "17,471").
- Growth includes sign and % (e.g. "-9.6%" or "+2.0%").
- For top_products: combine product name with price like "MMJ Card ($199)" so the price context is clear.
- For top_pages: use short paths only.
- whats_working: max 2 items. whats_not_working: 2-3 items. priority_actions: exactly 3.
- top_revenue_channels: top 3 by revenue.
- top_products: top 3 by revenue (exclude discounts/negative).
- top_queries, top_pages: exactly 3 items each.
- business_metrics: exactly 5 items. traffic_metrics: exactly 4 items.
- The headline should ALWAYS reference revenue or business impact, not just traffic.
- Output ONLY valid JSON. No markdown. No code fences. Start with { end with }.

nodes.name: Build Slack text and audio script

parameters.content:
## 1. Weekly trigger and settings
Every Monday one Set node holds the client name, property IDs, API key and the two date ranges used by every request below.

## 2. Pull the numbers
Thirteen requests run in parallel across GA4, Search Console and SegMetrics, covering this week and last week. A Code node also grades UTM tagging health.

## 3. Combine and write the brief
A merge waits for all thirteen sources, a Code node totals everything and works out week on week change, then an AI agent writes the executive brief as JSON.

## 4. Deliver to Slack
The JSON becomes formatted Slack text plus a spoken script, text to speech turns the script into an MP3, and both are posted as one message.

# Weekly marketing brief to Slack, with audio

Pulls a week of numbers from Google Analytics, Search Console and SegMetrics, has AI write an executive summary comparing it to the previous week, turns that summary into a short audio briefing, and posts both to Slack every Monday morning. Built so an account manager gets the story, not a dashboard link.

### How it works
1. A Monday schedule fires and one Set node holds every client setting: property IDs, API key, Slack channel and the two date ranges.
2. Thirteen requests run in parallel: GA4 traffic, channels and UTM data, Search Console clicks, queries and pages, and SegMetrics revenue, leads and ad spend. Each is fetched for both this week and last week.
3. A Code node grades UTM tagging health, flagging untagged or partly tagged campaigns.
4. A merge waits for all sources, then a Code node totals everything and calculates week on week change for every metric.
5. An AI agent writes the brief as structured JSON: a headline, business and traffic metrics, what is working, top channels and products, and three priority actions.
6. That JSON becomes formatted Slack text plus a spoken script. Text to speech renders the script as an MP3 and both are posted to Slack as one message.

### Setup
1. Connect your Google Analytics, Search Console, OpenAI and Slack credentials.
2. Open Set client config and replace every placeholder: client name, website, GA4 property ID, Search Console property, SegMetrics account ID and API key, and the Slack channel ID.
3. Invite your Slack app to that channel so it can upload files.

### Customization
Change the schedule for a daily brief, or edit the JSON structure in the AI agent prompt to add or drop sections.
